Employee.title: Employee
Employee.description: A natural person employed by the organisation. Carries the identity, payroll, and wage-tax attributes the payroll/wage-tax compliance checks read (BSN, tax table colour, ID-document retention, 30%-ruling, A1 posting, minimum-wage basis).

bsn.description: Burgerservicenummer (NL tax identification). Presence drives the anoniementarief check (nl-anoniementarief).

endDate.description: Employment end date, or null while active.

grossMonthlySalary.description: Gross monthly salary in the pay currency.

taxTableColor.description: Loonheffing tax table colour (wit = current employment, groen = pensions/benefits). Drives the combined loonheffing/volksverzekeringen levy (nl-loonheffingen-volksverzekeringen).

identityDocumentVerified.description: Whether a valid identity document was verified and copied into the loonadministratie (nl-id-bewaarplicht-5jaar).

identityDocumentRetainedUntil.description: Date until which the ID-document copy is retained — at least 5 years after the year employment ends (nl-id-bewaarplicht-5jaar).

loonheffingenVerklaringOnFile.description: Whether the employee's loonheffingenverklaring (wage-tax statement) is on file.

elstamRetrieved.description: DE: whether the ELStAM electronic wage-tax features were retrieved (de-elstam-abruf).

steuerklasse.description: DE: Lohnsteuer tax class (Steuerklasse I-VI) applied from ELStAM (de-elstam-abruf).

w4OnFile.description: US: whether a Form W-4 is on file for the employee (us-w4-on-file).

i9VerifiedWithinThreeDays.description: US: whether work eligibility was verified on Form I-9 within 3 business days of start (us-i9-verification).

newHireReportedDate.description: US: date the new hire was reported to the state Directory of New Hires (us-new-hire-reporting).

a1CertificateNumber.description: EU: A1 posted-worker certificate number, when the employee is posted (eu-a1-posted-worker).

a1ValidUntil.description: EU: A1 certificate expiry — max 24 months after posting start (eu-a1-posted-worker).

postedWorker.description: EU: whether the employee is posted to another member state remaining home-insured (eu-a1-posted-worker).

thirtyPercentRulingGranted.description: NL: whether a 30%-beschikking has been granted (nl-30-percent-regeling / nl-30-regeling-aftoppingsgrens).

thirtyPercentRulingRate.description: NL: applied 30%-ruling percentage; must not exceed 30 for 2025-2026 (nl-30-percent-regeling).

thirtyPercentCappedAtWntNorm.description: NL: whether the 30%-ruling tax-free base is capped at the WNT-norm (nl-30-regeling-aftoppingsgrens).

nextcloudUserId.description: The Nextcloud user id of this employee's own account, when they have one (mijn-hr-self-service). HR-maintained on the employee record; stays null for portal-only external employees, who keep using the UUID-claim-based portaliq scoping (ADR-046 A4). The durable Employee<->account link; per-record `userId` on Timesheet/Expense/LeaveRequest/Payslip is a denormalized copy of it.

iban.description: Bank account IBAN for net-pay SEPA credit transfers (payroll-sepa-netpay-shillinq). Shape check only — mod-97 checksum is a non-goal. Missing IBAN on a payable payroll run's payslip fails the net-pay batch closed (nl-netpay-iban-present).

tenaamstelling.description: Account-holder name as the bank knows it (payroll-sepa-netpay-shillinq) — printed as Cdtr/Nm on the SEPA credit transfer. Falls back to firstName + lastName when absent.

loonheffingskortingToegepast.description: Whether the employee elected on the loonbelastingverklaring to have the loonheffingskorting (heffingskortingen) applied by this employer (Rekenvoorschriften 2026 §2.2.3; drives the AHK/ARK application in the payroll engine — payroll-core-engine). Apply with at most one employer at a time; loonheffingenVerklaringOnFile records that the statement itself is archived.

administrationId.description: Denormalized administratie key this Employee is scoped to (multi-administratie, REQ-MULTI-001). Optional, nullable plain string -- NOT a $ref (ADR-062 rule 7, the PayrollRun convention): the manifest filter grammar cannot reach cross-schema relations, so this is maintained by HR/back-office when the record is created; the implicit page scoping (REQ-MULTI-004) filters on it and nl-administratie-scope-consistency (REQ-MULTI-007) audits every Employee-anchored child record against it.

isDga.description: NL: whether this employee is a DGA (directeur-grootaandeelhouder, director-major-shareholder/aanmerkelijkbelanghouder) -- not verzekeringsplichtig for the werknemersverzekeringen (dga-payroll-mode). A mode-switch on this record (ADR-001 Rule 4), never a separate app/schema: drives CalculationInput.verzekeringsplichtig via PayrollRunService and is the nl-gebruikelijkloon-norm check's scope gate.

gebruikelijkloonJustification.description: NL: free-text justification for a below-gebruikelijkloon-norm salary (dga-payroll-mode) -- one of the three statutory grounds (comparable-function salary, highest-paid-employee salary, or a lower amount substantiated to the Belastingdienst). MVP: presence-only exemption from nl-gebruikelijkloon-norm; content is not validated (named follow-up). Only meaningful when isDga is true.

EmploymentContract.title: Employment Contract
EmploymentContract.description: An employment agreement between the organisation and an employee. Carries the contract attributes the payroll checks read (permanent/temporary type that drives the Awf low/high premium, contracted hours, CAO, minimum-wage hourly basis).

employeeId.description: Reference to the Employee this contract belongs to.

type.description: Contract type. 'permanent' (written, indefinite) takes the Awf low tariff; flexible/temporary take the high tariff (nl-awf-laag-hoog-tarief).

writtenContract.description: Whether the contract is in writing — a precondition for the Awf low tariff (nl-awf-laag-hoog-tarief).

endDate.description: Contract end date, or null for indefinite.

hoursPerWeek.description: Contracted hours per week. Used with the statutory hourly minimum to derive period minimums (nl-minimumuurloon-wet).

hourlyWage.description: Gross hourly wage. Must meet the statutory minimum hourly wage (nl-minimumloon-2026 / nl-minimumuurloon-wet / de-mindestlohn-2026 / fr-smic-2026 / us-flsa-minimum-wage).

cao.description: Applicable collective labour agreement: the id of a CAO in the maintained library (lib/Standards/cao/{cao}.json, e.g. cao-generiek / cao-metaal-techniek / cao-horeca), resolvable through CaoRegistry. Null when the contract follows no CAO. Drives the below-CAO-minimum audit checks (nl-cao-minimumloon-schaal on this contract's salary, nl-cao-verlof-minimum on the employee's leave).

caoSchaal.description: The pay scale (schaal) within the referenced CAO's loontabel (e.g. 'A', 'B', 'II') that this contract is paid on. Null when no scale is set — the pay-scale check (nl-cao-minimumloon-schaal) is then vacuous. Only meaningful together with a non-null cao.

awfTariff.description: Applied Awf (unemployment fund) tariff — low for permanent written contracts, high otherwise (nl-awf-laag-hoog-tarief).

workingTimeDocumented.description: DE: whether daily working time is recorded within 7 days and retained ≥2 years for §17 MiLoG sectors/Minijobs (de-mindestlohn-arbeitszeit-doku).

overtimeMultiplier.description: US: overtime pay multiplier for hours over 40/week for non-exempt employees — must be ≥1.5 (us-flsa-overtime).

ftePartOfYearMinijob.description: DE: whether the contract is a Minijob within the geringfügige Beschäftigung threshold using flat-rate contributions (de-minijob-pauschale).

dpaeFiledBeforeStart.description: FR: whether the Déclaration Préalable À l'Embauche (DPAE) was filed in the 8 days before the hire (fr-dpae).

aanzegdOn.title: Aanzegd on
aanzegdOn.description: NL: date the written aanzegging (BW 7:668 lid 1) was sent to the employee, informing whether a fixed-term contract of six months or longer will be continued. Must be on or before endDate minus one month to satisfy nl-aanzegtermijn-bewaking.

administrationId.description: Denormalized administratie key this EmploymentContract is scoped to (multi-administratie, REQ-MULTI-001). Optional, nullable plain string -- NOT a $ref (ADR-062 rule 7, the PayrollRun convention), mirroring its owning Employee's administrationId; maintained by HR/back-office and audited for drift by nl-administratie-scope-consistency (REQ-MULTI-007).

Payslip.title: Payslip
Payslip.description: A per-employee, per-period wage statement (loonstrook / Lohnabrechnung / bulletin de paie / pay stub). Carries the gross-to-net composition the payroll-withholding, social-security, and statutory-content checks read.

userId.description: Denormalized Nextcloud user id of the employee this payslip belongs to (mijn-hr-self-service). Plain NC-user-id string, never a $ref — mirrors the approvedBy convention on Timesheet/Expense. Employees never author their own payslip, so this is set by payroll alongside employeeId when the payslip is generated; the read-only MijnLoonstroken self-service page filters on it with the @me token.

period.description: Wage period in YYYY-MM (or YYYY-Pnn for four-weekly).

jurisdiction.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country whose payroll rules govern this payslip (NL/DE/FR/US).

grossPay.description: Gross wage for the period (BR for loonstrook content).

hoursWorked.description: Hours worked in the period; with grossPay yields the effective hourly rate for minimum-wage checks.

loonheffing.description: NL: combined loonheffing (loonbelasting + premie volksverzekeringen) withheld (nl-loonheffingen-inhouding / nl-loonheffingen-volksverzekeringen).

volksverzekeringen.description: NL: premie volksverzekeringen portion within the loonheffing (nl-loonheffingen-volksverzekeringen).

werknemersverzekeringen.description: NL: employer-borne premies werknemersverzekeringen (WW/WIA/ZW) over the wage (nl-werknemersverzekeringen-werkgever). Zero for a DGA (isDga true, dga-payroll-mode) -- see isDga.

isDga.description: NL: denormalized copy of Employee.isDga at calculation time (dga-payroll-mode) -- true means this employee is a DGA (director-major-shareholder), not verzekeringsplichtig for the werknemersverzekeringen (Awf/Aof/Wko/Whk), so werknemersverzekeringen reads zero by design rather than by engine defect. loonheffing/volksverzekeringen/zvw/nettoPay are unaffected.

zvw.description: NL: Zvw contribution (werkgeversheffing or withheld bijdrage) for the period (nl-zvw-werkgeversheffing / nl-zvw-inhouding).

zvwMode.description: NL: whether the Zvw is the employer levy (6,10%) or the withheld lower rate (4,85%) (nl-zvw-werkgeversheffing / nl-zvw-inhouding).

zvwRate.description: NL: applied Zvw rate percentage (6.10 for werkgeversheffing, 4.85 for inhouding).

anoniementariefApplied.description: NL: whether the 52% anoniementarief was applied because identity/BSN data is missing (nl-anoniementarief).

appliedTaxRate.description: NL: effective loonheffing rate percentage applied; 52 when the anoniementarief is in force (nl-anoniementarief).

nettoPay.description: Net wage paid to the employee.

vakantiegeldReserved.description: Vakantiebijslag reserved this period — at least 8% of gross (nl-vakantiebijslag-8procent).

vakantiegeldRate.description: Applied vakantiebijslag rate percentage — at least 8 (nl-vakantiebijslag-8procent).

wkrUsed.description: NL: designated WKR allowances charged this period against the vrije ruimte (nl-wkr-vrije-ruimte).

wkrVrijeRuimteRemaining.description: NL: remaining WKR vrije ruimte after this payslip — must not go negative without eindheffing (nl-wkr-vrije-ruimte).

wkrEindheffingRate.description: NL: 80% eindheffing rate applied to WKR excess (nl-wkr-eindheffing-80).

wkrExcess.description: NL: WKR allowances exceeding the vrije ruimte that attract the 80% eindheffing (nl-wkr-eindheffing-80).

pensionContribution.description: Employee pension contribution withheld for the period.

statementProvided.description: Whether a written/electronic payslip was provided to the employee.

showsGrossWage.description: NL/FR: whether the payslip states the gross wage (nl-loonstrook-inhoud / fr-bulletin-de-paie-mentions).

showsDeductionBasis.description: NL: whether the payslip states the amount and basis of each deduction (nl-loonstrook-inhoud).

showsMinimumWage.description: NL: whether the payslip states the applicable statutory minimum wage (nl-loonstrook-inhoud).

showsEmployerEmployeeIds.description: NL: whether the payslip states employer and employee identification (nl-loonstrook-inhoud).

lohnsteuer.description: DE: Lohnsteuer withheld for the period (de-lohnsteuer-einbehalt).

solidaritaetszuschlag.description: DE: Solidaritätszuschlag of 5,5% of the Lohnsteuer above the Freigrenze (de-solidaritaetszuschlag).

solzApplicable.description: DE: whether the Soli applies (employee above the Freigrenze) (de-solidaritaetszuschlag).

kirchensteuer.description: DE: Kirchensteuer (8%/9% of Lohnsteuer) where the employee is a church member (de-kirchensteuer).

kirchensteuerRate.description: DE: applied Kirchensteuer rate percentage (8 or 9) (de-kirchensteuer).

churchMember.description: DE: whether the employee is a member of a tax-collecting religious community (de-kirchensteuer).

kvBaseRate.description: DE: general health-insurance base rate — 14,6% for 2026 (de-kv-beitragssatz-2026).

svContributionBase.description: DE: social-security contribution base used for RV/AV (capped at the BBG) (de-bbg-rv-av-2026).

kvPvContributionBase.description: DE: KV/PV contribution base (capped at the KV/PV BBG) (de-bbg-kv-pv-2026).

ficaSsWageBaseApplied.description: US: Social Security taxable wage capped at the annual wage base (us-social-security-wage-base-2026).

additionalMedicareApplied.description: US: whether the additional 0,9% Medicare tax applies (wages over $200k YTD) (us-additional-medicare-tax).

federalIncomeTaxWithheld.description: US: federal income tax withheld using Form W-4 / Pub. 15-T (us-federal-income-tax-withholding).

netImposable.description: FR: net imposable shown on the bulletin de paie (fr-bulletin-de-paie-mentions).

netAPayer.description: FR: net à payer shown on the bulletin de paie (fr-bulletin-de-paie-mentions).

montantNetSocial.description: FR: montant net social — standardised reference amount on the bulletin (fr-montant-net-social).

cotisations.description: FR: total URSSAF social cotisations on the gross assiette (fr-urssaf-cotisations).

prelevementSource.description: FR: prélèvement à la source income tax withheld (fr-prelevement-a-la-source).

pasRate.description: FR: PAS rate transmitted by the administration via DSN (fr-prelevement-a-la-source).

reductionGeneraleApplied.description: FR: whether the réduction générale (ex-Fillon) is applied on remuneration below 1,6 SMIC (fr-reduction-generale).

conventionCollective.description: FR: applicable convention collective shown on the bulletin (fr-bulletin-de-paie-mentions).

retainedUntil.description: Date until which the payslip duplicate is retained — 5 years FR (fr-bulletin-conservation) / 4-year IRC + 3-year FLSA US.

arbeidskorting.description: NL: applied arbeidskorting for the period (tijdvakbedrag) — the witte-tabel column the Rekenvoorschriften §2.2.3.4 require the loonadministratie to record. Set by the payroll engine; null on hand-entered payslips (nl-engine-output-consistency context).

payrollRunId.description: The PayrollRun that generated this payslip (payroll-core-engine). Null for hand-entered payslips. Drives idempotent recalculation and the run-scoped compliance verify (nl-engine-output-consistency scoping).

sickLeaveCaseId.description: NL: the open SickLeaveCase this payslip's doorbetaald loon was computed for (sick-pay-calc). Null on a normal (non-sick) payslip — marks the sick-pay fields and the nl-loondoorbetaling-floor check as in scope.

doorbetaaldLoon.description: NL: the floored loondoorbetaling-bij-ziekte continued wage before the wachtdag deduction (SickPayCalculator L). Null on a normal payslip (sick-pay-calc).

wachtdagDeduction.description: NL: the once-per-case wachtdag (waiting day) deduction, valued at the doorbetaald daily rate. 0 when no wachtdag applies; null on a normal payslip (sick-pay-calc).

sickPayReferenceWage.description: NL: the reference wage (W) the sick-pay calculation was run against — the employee's full grossMonthlySalary. Null on a normal payslip (sick-pay-calc).

sickPayPercentage.description: NL: the applied loondoorbetalingPercentage (statutory minimum 70, CAOs may set higher). Null on a normal payslip (sick-pay-calc).

sickPayMinimumWageFloor.description: NL: the WML monthly floor (M) this sick payslip's year-1 floor was computed against, part-time scaled. Null on a normal payslip (sick-pay-calc).

sickPayYearOne.description: NL: whether the run period fell within the first 52 weeks of the case's firstSickDay — the year-1 WML floor is in scope only when true. Null on a normal payslip (sick-pay-calc).

retroAdjustment.description: Summed net TWK (terugwerkende kracht) retro-adjustment delta settled into THIS payslip's period -- a nabetaling (positive) or terugvordering (negative) rolled up from every applied PayrollAdjustment whose settlementPeriod equals this payslip's period (retro-adjustments). Included in nettoPay. Null when no adjustment settles this period; the sealed historical payslip this delta was diffed against is never touched.

leaveBuySell.description: Summed net leave buy/sell effect settled into THIS payslip's period -- a payment (positive, sold hours) or a deduction (negative, bought hours) rolled up from every settled LeaveTransaction whose settlementPeriod equals this payslip's period (leave-buy-sell). Included in nettoPay, folded on top of any retroAdjustment. Null when no transaction settles this period. Computed once by LeaveBuySellSettlementService at settle time -- PayrollCalculator never (re)computes this figure.

loonbeslag.description: The floor-clamped court/deurwaarder wage-garnishment deduction folded into THIS payslip's period (loonbeslag): deduction = min(orderedAmount, max(0, nettoPay - beslagvrijeVoet)) against the fully-folded nettoPay (engine net + retroAdjustment + leaveBuySell). Included in nettoPay, folded AFTER retroAdjustment/leaveBuySell -- the beslagvrije voet protects the employee's actual take-home this period, never an intermediate figure. Null when deductionCents is 0 (no active Loonbeslag covers this period, or the employee already has no headroom above the voet). PayrollCalculator is never invoked for this figure -- entirely post-tax arithmetic in PayrollRunService.

loonbeslagId.description: The actief Loonbeslag this payslip's garnishment deduction was computed against (loonbeslag). Null when no actief Loonbeslag covers this payslip's period -- marks the nl-loonbeslag-beslagvrije-voet-floor check as in scope.

bijtelling.description: NL: the monthly bijtelling privegebruik auto (company-car private-use addition, fleet-bijtelling) folded into THIS payslip's taxable gross BEFORE the calculator ran: monthlyBijtelling = round(cataloguswaarde x bijtellingPct / 12) - eigenBijdrage, floored at 0. Included in grossPay (the calculator's tvl already contains it) -- unlike retroAdjustment/leaveBuySell/loonbeslag, which fold onto nettoPay post-tax, bijtelling is an engine-INPUT change. Null when no covering CarAssignment applied -- marks the nl-bijtelling-auto-privegebruik check as in scope.

carAssignmentId.description: NL: the open CarAssignment this payslip's bijtelling was computed against (fleet-bijtelling). Null when no CarAssignment covers this payslip's period -- byte-identical to a payslip with no company car.

administrationId.description: Denormalized administratie key this Payslip is scoped to (multi-administratie, REQ-MULTI-001). Optional, nullable plain string -- NOT a $ref (ADR-062 rule 7); maintained by payroll alongside employeeId. nl-administratie-scope-consistency (REQ-MULTI-007) audits it against the producing payrollRunId's PayrollRun.administrationId (the parent, not the employee -- design.md D6).

PayrollRun.title: Payroll Run
PayrollRun.description: A per-period payroll batch that aggregates the payslips of one administration. Carries the period totals the payroll-to-GL reconciliation and liability-clearing controls read.

administrationId.description: The administration/employer this run belongs to. No Administration schema is modeled in hrmq — plain string, not a $ref relation (ADR-062 rule 7: only fields whose target exists in this register set get $ref).

jurisdiction.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country governing this run.

totalGross.description: Total gross wages for the period.

totalLoonheffing.description: Total loonheffing / wage tax withheld for the period.

totalEmployerCharges.description: Total employer social charges for the period.

totalWithholdings.description: Total employee withholdings (tax + social) for the period.

totalNet.description: Total net pay for the period.

glLiabilityPosted.description: Amount posted to payroll liability accounts in the GL — must reconcile to gross+employer charges−net (xc-payroll-gl-reconciliation).

glExpensePosted.description: Amount posted to payroll expense accounts in the GL — must reconcile to gross+employer charges (xc-payroll-gl-reconciliation).

withholdingsClearedToZero.description: Whether each tax/social withholding liability was cleared to zero when remitted (xc-withholding-liability-clearing).

withholdingLiabilityBalance.description: Residual withholding-liability balance after remittance — zero when cleared (xc-withholding-liability-clearing).

calculatedAt.description: When the payroll engine (re)calculated this run's payslips and totals (nl-engine-table-version). Null for hand-entered runs.

engineVersion.description: Versioned tax-year table file that produced this run (e.g. nl-2026 -> lib/Standards/tables/nl-2026.json) (nl-engine-table-version). Null for hand-entered runs.

PayrollMutationReport.title: Payroll Mutation Report
PayrollMutationReport.description: The persisted per-run payroll diff an accountant reviews before approving a run (payroll-mutation-reports): who joined/left and each shared employee's per-component cents delta between two PayrollRuns, plus the run-level roll-up totals. Produced ONLY by PayrollMutationService — a pure, read-only subtraction over the two runs' already-persisted Payslips, never a recomputation. Idempotently keyed on (fromRunId, toRunId): regenerating the same pair upserts this record in place.

fromRunId.description: The baseline PayrollRun this report diffs from. Null on a first run — no prior period exists (design.md D5).

fromPeriod.description: Baseline wage period, YYYY-MM. Empty/null on a first run.

administrationId.description: The administration both runs belong to (a cross-administration pair is refused, never diffed).

enteredCount.description: Employees present only in the `to` run.

leftCount.description: Employees present only in the `from` run.

changedCount.description: Shared employees with any headline-component delta (= changedEmployeeCount).

unchangedCount.description: Shared employees with all four headline components equal.

grossDelta.description: Sum of to.grossPay minus sum of from.grossPay, over the union of employees.

netDelta.description: Sum of to.nettoPay minus sum of from.nettoPay, over the union of employees.

loonheffingDelta.description: Sum of to.loonheffing minus sum of from.loonheffing, over the union of employees.

employerCostDelta.description: Sum of to.(werknemersverzekeringen+zvw) minus sum of from, over the union of employees.

totalWageCostDelta.description: grossDelta + employerCostDelta — the accountant's headline total wage-cost change.

lines.title: Mutation lines
lines.description: Per-employee mutation rows: classification (entered/left/changed/unchanged) plus the four headline components' before/after/delta.

employeeId.description: The employee this mutation line concerns.

LoonaangifteFiling.title: Wage Tax Filing
LoonaangifteFiling.description: A wage-tax / social-security filing for one wage period (NL loonaangifte / DE Lohnsteuer-Anmeldung & Beitragsnachweis / FR DSN / US Form 941 & deposits). Carries the period, deadline, submission, and tijdvak attributes the filing-window checks read. For NL, the filing also carries a declarative create->review->confirm->send lifecycle (concept -> klaargezet -> bevestigd -> verzonden) plus tijdvakcode/response-capture fields (loonaangifte-filing-lifecycle).

klaarzetten.description: Marks the filing as review-ready. Requires period, tijdvak, tijdvakcode and deadline to be present (schema-required plus the nl-loonaangifte-tijdvakcode / nl-loonaangifte-deadline-derivation checks).

bevestigen.description: Confirms the reviewed filing for dispatch to the Belastingdienst.

verzenden.description: Marks the filing as sent. submittedDate and verzondenDoor are stamped on the carrying write (the Timesheet approvedAt/approvedBy pattern); electronicallyFiled is set by the writer.

heropenen.description: Reopens a not-yet-sent filing for correction before it is confirmed or sent.

corrigeren.description: A sent filing can be superseded by a correction (NL allows correcties binnen het tijdvak). The usual route is a NEW filing object for the same period; this transition's reset-to-concept semantics are a simplified placeholder — full correctie-berichten (VL/IB-correcties) are a future spec.

period.description: Wage period the filing covers, in YYYY-MM.

jurisdiction.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country governing this filing (NL/DE/FR/US).

filingType.description: Filing kind: loonaangifte / lohnsteuer-anmeldung / beitragsnachweis / deuv-meldung / lohnsteuerbescheinigung / dsn / form-941 / form-940 / deposit / form-w2.

tijdvak.description: Filing period type (tijdvak / Anmeldungszeitraum / deposit schedule) (nl-loonaangifte-tijdvak / de-lohnsteuer-anmeldungszeitraum / us-deposit-schedule-lookback).

deadline.description: Statutory filing/payment deadline (ISO 8601). NL: last working day of the month after the period (nl-loonaangifte-termijn). DE: 10th of the following month (de-lohnsteuer-anmeldung). FR: 5th/15th (fr-dsn-echeance). US: last day of month after quarter (us-form-941-quarterly).

submittedDate.description: Date the filing was submitted electronically — must be on or before the deadline.

paidDate.description: Date the related contributions/taxes were paid.

electronicallyFiled.description: Whether the filing was submitted electronically (nl-loonaangifte-tijdvak / de-lohnsteuer-anmeldung / fr-dsn-mensuelle / us-eftps-deposit).

priorYearLiability.description: DE: prior-year Lohnsteuer that determines the Anmeldungszeitraum thresholds (de-lohnsteuer-anmeldungszeitraum).

lookbackLiability.description: US: employment-tax liability in the lookback period that sets the deposit schedule (us-deposit-schedule-lookback).

depositSchedule.description: US: federal deposit schedule derived from the lookback liability (us-deposit-monthly / us-deposit-semiweekly).

accumulatedLiability.description: US: accumulated employment-tax liability driving the $100k next-day and $500 FUTA deposit rules (us-deposit-100k-next-day / us-futa-deposit-500).

nextDayDepositMade.description: US: whether a next-business-day deposit was made when liability reached $100k (us-deposit-100k-next-day).

eventSignalDays.description: FR: working days taken to transmit an event signalement — must be ≤5 (fr-dsn-evenementielle).

furnishedToRecipientDate.description: US/DE: date the year-end statement (W-2 to employee, Lohnsteuerbescheinigung) was furnished (us-form-w2-to-employee / de-lohnsteuerbescheinigung).

filedWithAuthorityDate.description: US: date Copy A / W-3 transmittal was filed with the SSA (us-form-w2-w3-to-ssa).

returnCountInYear.description: US: aggregate information returns filed in the year, driving the 10-return e-file rule (us-w2-efile-threshold).

retainedUntil.description: Date until which the filing records are retained (NL 7yr / DE 6yr / US 4yr).

status.title: Status
status.description: NL filing lifecycle status. Governed by the x-openregister-lifecycle state machine (concept -> klaargezet -> bevestigd -> verzonden). DE/FR/US filings are unaffected by the lifecycle and stay at the default.

tijdvakcode.title: Tijdvakcode
tijdvakcode.description: Official Belastingdienst numeric period code (Handboek Loonheffingen LH 210, 2026 edition), matching this filing's period + tijdvak (nl-loonaangifte-tijdvakcode). Maand: one code per calendar month (6010 = January 2026 .. 6120 = December 2026). Vierweken: thirteen four-weekly codes (6710, 6750, 6790, 6830, 6870, 6910, 6950, 6990, 7030, 7070, 7110, 7150, 7190 = periods 1-13). Jaar: 6400. The authoritative table is data, not hard-coded here — see the nl-loonaangifte-tijdvakcode rule's `parameters` in lib/Standards/rules/payroll.json; it is re-issued annually by the Belastingdienst alongside the Gegevensspecificaties, so a new year is a data-only change.

aangiftenummer.title: Aangiftenummer
aangiftenummer.description: Loonheffingennummer + tijdvakcode composite identifier the Belastingdienst uses to key this filing.

betalingskenmerk.title: Betalingskenmerk
betalingskenmerk.description: Payment reference the Belastingdienst issues for this filing period's remittance.

responseStatus.title: Response status
responseStatus.description: Outcome of the Belastingdienst response to a sent filing. A rejected (afgekeurd) filing is corrected via the corrigeren transition; no automated polling/ingestion happens in this app.

responseMessage.title: Response message
responseMessage.description: Free-text Belastingdienst response message (acceptance note or rejection reason).

verzondenDoor.title: Verzonden door
verzondenDoor.description: Display name of the person who sent the filing, stamped on the verzenden carrying write (the Timesheet approvedBy pattern).

administrationId.description: Denormalized administratie key this filing is scoped to (multi-administratie, REQ-MULTI-001). Optional, nullable plain string -- NOT a $ref (ADR-062 rule 7, the PayrollRun convention); an organisation-level filing has no employee/parent to derive it from, so nl-administratie-scope-consistency does not evaluate this schema.

WkrDeclaration.title: WKR Declaration
WkrDeclaration.description: One recorded werkkostenregeling (WKR) vergoeding/verstrekking/terbeschikkingstelling for an administration (wkr-administration): a company-wide allowance/benefit (staff outing, Christmas hamper, fixed-cost allowance) or an employee-specific one, categorised so the administration-level vrije-ruimte roll-up (WkrService) knows whether it consumes the vrije ruimte, stays outside it as a gerichte vrijstelling, or was already designated eindheffingsloon.

administrationId.description: The administration this declaration belongs to (wkr-administration REQ-WKR-001). Plain string, not a $ref (ADR-062 rule 7, the PayrollRun convention -- no Administration schema is modeled in hrmq).

year.description: Fiscal year this declaration counts toward -- the vrije ruimte is a whole-year budget (wkr-administration REQ-WKR-001).

date.description: Date the allowance/benefit was granted, invoiced, or made available.

description.description: Free-text description of the vergoeding/verstrekking (e.g. "Personeelsuitje juni").

wkrCategory.description: WKR classification (wkr-administration REQ-WKR-001, design.md D1): `vrije-ruimte` consumes the administration's vrije ruimte; `gericht-vrijgesteld` is a statutory gerichte vrijstelling that stays outside it (nl-wkr-gerichte-vrijstelling, judgemental, unchanged by this schema); `eindheffing` is loon the employer already designated as eindheffingsloon. Only `vrije-ruimte` amounts are summed into vrijeRuimteUsed.

employeeId.description: The employee this declaration concerns, or null for a collective/company-wide allowance (wkr-administration REQ-WKR-001).

sourceReference.description: Invoice/journal reference for the audit trail (e.g. "INV-2026-0612").

WkrAssessment.title: WKR Assessment
WkrAssessment.description: The per-(administrationId, year) computed vrije-ruimte/eindheffing summary AND the reporting record (wkr-administration, the PayrollMutationReport precedent): produced ONLY by WkrService::assess(), rolling the cross-object fiscale loonsom (Σ Payslip.grossPay) and the administration's WkrDeclarations into the available vrije ruimte, the used amount, the excess and the 80% eindheffing exposure. Idempotently keyed on (administrationId, year): recomputing upserts this record in place, never duplicates. Persisting the assessment as a real object (rather than a transient calculation) is what makes nl-wkr-eindheffing-exposure RuleEngine-reachable -- the standing audit loads every WkrAssessment and checks it automatically.

administrationId.description: The administration this assessment covers (wkr-administration REQ-WKR-003). Idempotent key together with year -- plain string, not a $ref (ADR-062 rule 7, the PayrollRun convention).

year.description: The fiscal year this assessment covers (wkr-administration REQ-WKR-003).

fiscaleLoonsom.description: Σ Payslip.grossPay over this administration/year -- the fiscale-loonsom proxy WkrService reads (design.md Risks: an honest, auditable proxy for the exact kolom-14 loonsom, never a recomputed payroll figure).

vrijeRuimte.description: Available vrije ruimte, computed from fiscaleLoonsom against the `wkr` group tranche percentages/grens in the active tax-year table (wkr-administration REQ-WKR-002).

vrijeRuimteUsed.description: Σ Payslip.wkrUsed + Σ WkrDeclaration.amount where wkrCategory = 'vrije-ruimte', for this administration/year.

excess.description: vrijeRuimteUsed minus vrijeRuimte when positive, else 0 -- the amount subject to the 80% eindheffing.

eindheffingRate.description: The eindheffing rate (80, from the `wkr` table group) applied to the excess; null when excess is 0 (nl-wkr-eindheffing-exposure).

eindheffingDue.description: 80% of excess, rounded to the cent -- the eindheffing the employer owes over the vrije-ruimte overrun (settlement itself is a named fast-follow, not automated by this schema).

status.description: Whether the administration/year stayed within its vrije ruimte, or an eindheffing is owed over the excess (wkr-administration REQ-WKR-003/-WKR-004).

engineVersion.description: The tables id (e.g. "nl-2026") this assessment's vrije-ruimte/eindheffing figures were computed against.

assessedAt.description: When this assessment was (re)computed by WkrService::assess().
